reviews.body: Hello, I am Korean. I don’t know English very well, so I am using a translator; please excuse any awkward phrasing. This morning, all of my accounts were temporarily suspended. I received a notification stating that there was "inappropriate activity" on my Instagram. I was simply doing what I always do—watching videos and exchanging messages with friends—so I have no idea what I could have done wrong to trigger this suspension. How can I go about recovering my accounts? I feel truly, deeply wronged. Thank you for taking the time to read this.
reviews.title: Please!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.body: 원래는 정말 잘 썼습니다. 그런데 며칠전 이전 계정이 이유없이 비활성화되어 다 잃어버리고 새 계정을 생성했지만 이전 팔로워들을 다시 맞팔로우하는 과정에서 팔로우 일일한도가 걸려 불편합니다. 신고를 여러번해도 뭐가 되고있는지 모르겠고요. 카메라에 필터도 모조리 사라지고 버그가 끊이지 않습니다
